name: Fast Harness Small Campaign 2026-06-09
description: Proxy-first validation for known governance/routing risk classes plus MCP smoke before spending live Codex or official SWE-Pro evaluator time.

entries.task: Official patch task shape: Fix QtWebEngine rendering glitches by adding a Chromium workaround setting. Prefer runtime args plus config schema surfaces; avoid broad backend diagnostic context.

Official patch task shape: Support deprecation by date in modules. Deprecated aliases should validate version or date and display warnings. Avoid generic date/url helpers unless parsing helpers are explicitly requested.

Official patch task shape: Fix voice broadcast liveness icon inconsistent feedback while recording and playback are active. Prefer visible component ownership and only include hooks/models/index surfaces when state or shared types are required.

Control task shape: Kubernetes RBAC namespace rules should grant expected resource access. A role rule with kind namespace grants get list watch resources in the namespace. Prefer resource matchers before service startup code.
Control task shape: /lists/add returns a 500 when POST data conflicts with query parameters. Prefer request/form conflict handling and nearby tests; avoid broad unrelated utility context.
